subject.title: Add Message Rate Limiting for Feishu Channel

question: Should OpenClaw accept a Feishu-owned, default-off sendRateLimit.minIntervalMs config contract for proactive per-target outbound pacing?
rationale: Source inspection shows the gap, but adding a new operator-facing Feishu config key and deciding whether the linked PR's runtime-seam proof is enough require maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Accept Default-Off Feishu Pacing
options.body: Review the linked PR or a replacement toward a default-off per-account/per-target sendRateLimit.minIntervalMs setting across burstable Feishu sends.

options.title: Keep Only Reactive Retry
options.body: Reject the new config surface and document that OpenClaw relies on the existing Feishu retry/backoff behavior after rate-limit responses.

options.title: Move Scope To Broad Limiter
options.body: Defer Feishu-specific pacing and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/13615 own cross-provider queueing or rate-limit policy.

recommendation.title: Accept Default-Off Feishu Pacing
recommendation.body: Review the linked PR or a replacement toward a default-off per-account/per-target sendRateLimit.minIntervalMs setting across burstable Feishu sends.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the community-maintained Feishu plugin owner candidate for Feishu-owned send behavior.
